plain: Kirk McConnell, a staffer in the US Senate in Washington, says that in the 2020s his office wanted people with inside knowledge of UFOs to come forward. He says that well-known figures in the field, including Hal Puthoff, Eric Davis, David Grusch, Lou Elizondo and Chris Mellon, all told the staff that they know such people. In his telling, those sources hold back, which would mean there is more inside knowledge than has yet reached Congress.
